capabilities.rationale: Account and sleeve binding must resolve correctly before any submission authority can be trusted.
The current-day startup materialization is the baseline control-plane precondition for both paper and production.
The governed posture artifact confirms current-day authority, freshness, linkage, and operator trading enablement.
A truthful positive IB handshake is required before any paper or production submission capability can be claimed.
Capital risk, correlation, liquidity, and operator daily gates encode the minimum safe execution envelope for paper and production.
Feed attestation, heartbeat, and replay certification remain production-critical, but they are certification burdens rather than core paper execution capability.
